title: Panel cannot reach monitoring center
shortDescription: Failure to communicate with ADT central station.
fullDescription: The panel tried to contact ADT and could not reach it via phone, cellular, or broadband. If cellular backup is active it will be displayed.

fixSteps.title: Check internet
fixSteps.instruction: Verify router and modem are online.

fixSteps.title: Silence trouble
fixSteps.instruction: Press Status or * to silence; if persists 30 min, call ADT.

whenToCallPro: Call ADT if fault persists over 30 minutes.

title: Sensor or panel battery low
shortDescription: One or more wireless sensor batteries need replacing.
fullDescription: Panel reports the zone with low battery. Wireless sensors use lithium batteries that last 3-5 years.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Open sensor, replace with matching CR123 or CR2032.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is hard to access.

title: Sensor cover or tamper switch triggered
shortDescription: Device cover opened or not seated.
fullDescription: Tamper alerts indicate a sensor cover was opened or the device came loose from its mount.

fixSteps.title: Reseat sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure cover snaps fully on mount.

title: Sensor not checking in with panel
shortDescription: Panel has not heard from a sensor within supervisory window.
fullDescription: Each sensor sends a supervisory beacon. After missed intervals panel reports offline.

fixSteps.title: Check battery
fixSteps.instruction: Replace sensor battery if older than 2 years.

fixSteps.title: Test beacon
fixSteps.instruction: Trigger sensor and confirm panel beep.

title: Panel Ethernet connection lost
shortDescription: Broadband link to panel is offline.
fullDescription: Panel fails to ping internet. Check cable and router.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug/replug Ethernet on panel and router.

whenToCallPro: If internet works but panel won't connect.

title: System running on cellular
shortDescription: Primary internet failed; cellular backup in use.
fullDescription: This is informational. When internet is restored, system returns to broadband.

title: System triggered unintended alarm
shortDescription: Alarm went off without real intrusion.
fullDescription: Common causes: pets, drafts, improper arming, or door not fully closed.

fixSteps.title: Disarm and cancel
fixSteps.instruction: Enter code to disarm; call ADT to cancel dispatch.

fixSteps.title: Pet-immune sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Request pet-immune PIRs for next install.

faq.a: Some cities fine repeat false alarms.

title: Entry delay expired without disarm
shortDescription: User did not disarm in time, triggering alarm.
fullDescription: Panel beeped for entry delay but no code was entered. Check entry delay duration if too short.

fixSteps.title: Adjust delay
fixSteps.instruction: Ask ADT to extend entry delay to 60-90s.

whenToCallPro: To change delay on some panels.

title: Panel AC power lost
fullDescription: Power outage or tripped breaker cut AC to panel.
whenToCallPro: If AC remains lost with power restored.

title: One or more zones bypassed
shortDescription: Zones set to bypass; they will not alarm.
fullDescription: Bypass may be intentional (open window overnight) or a stuck sensor.

fixSteps.title: Remove bypass
fixSteps.instruction: Select zone and remove bypass on panel.
